_doc: Manifest of KDE tray icons delivered by my-konsole. Each entry launches `my-konsole --profile <profile>` (initial-profile CLI support pending, see TODO below) instead of a separate per-tray app.
_TODO: my-konsole has no --profile / initial-tab CLI arg yet — profiles are currently only selectable from inside the running app's UI. Needs a small Rust (main.rs, read MY_KONSOLE_INITIAL_PROFILE env) + frontend (select that tab on mount) addition before these trays can jump straight to their profile.
